security_boundaries.behavior: planner_read_only_runtime_profile returns read_only sandbox and no capabilities; ensure_planner_runtime_profile rejects write/tool execution capabilities.
PlannerOutputValidator compiles PlanDraft through the existing PlanIR compiler and adds total node/depth/model/tool/spawn/wall/cost limits before returning an executable PlanIR.
PlannerContextBuilder creates deterministic ContextManifest and planner input artifacts; planner output artifacts bind release digest and Context Manifest digest.
AgentDriver planner adapters fail with structured PlannerFailure records and never fall back to another driver; CodexSDKDriver now passes through PlanDraft after explicit output contract validation.

Repair validation accepts only validated trigger types, enforces repair-cycle budget, compiles PlanPatchDraft into a new full PlanIR version, and requires unchanged nodes to reference reusable Evidence.

acceptance_map.criterion: Planner roles receive read-only runtime profiles and no project write grants.
Malformed, uncovered, cyclic, over-budget or over-privileged drafts fail before execution.
Planner input/output are content-addressed artifacts with release and Context Manifest digests.
Fixture planner tests deterministic/no external account.
Optional model adapter failures structured and cannot silently fall back to another driver.
A Defect can produce bounded PlanPatchDraft while unchanged nodes and Evidence remain referenced.

known_limitations: Planner output remains untrusted until PlannerOutputValidator returns an accepted PlanIR and validation report.
AcceptancePlanner adapter is a provider-neutral structured path; this task does not promote a model-generated ClaimGraph without the existing acceptance contract validator.
The implementation is a local reference-core slice, not a distributed planner service or durable planner queue.
